text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer squeezed out every last drop 
of strength, but victory in the Satsuki 
Sho was not meant to be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Mejiro Ryan comments that 
Mejiro Palmer has "changed." Namely, that 
her expression has grown much fiercer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That was proof that she had gradually 
become able to show her true seriousness. 
Mejiro Palmer vowed to continue changing 
people's impressions of her.
